steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each line's demand is placed against its capacity by quarter.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 quarter has a gap and no action

findings.title: Gap with no action
findings.fix: Name the action that closes the gap

findings.title: Capacity with no basis
findings.fix: Give the basis for the capacity

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] line-2-q1.csv:12  Gap with no action.
       Fix: Name the action that closes the gap.
[medium] forecast-source.md:19  Forecast with no source.
       Fix: Name the forecast's source.
[low] capacity-basis.md:26  Capacity with no basis.
       Fix: Give the basis for the capacity.
Not checked: Demand not in the forecast.
pros: Checks a gap with no action, a forecast with no source, and a capacity with no basis.
cons: Not checked: Demand not in the forecast.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-mfg-capacity-plan skill on the records for this review.
